name: invgate-service-desk-mcp
description: MCP server for the InvGate Service Desk API (incidents, users, KB, workflows, assets).
long_description: Exposes InvGate Service Desk operations as MCP tools: incidents CRUD and filtering, users and groups, custom fields, knowledge base, workflows, assets/CIs, breaking news, triggers, time tracking, and data export. Read-only by default; write operations are opt-in via INVGATE_WRITE_PROFILE (none | support | full).

INVGATE_BASE_URL.title: InvGate Base URL
INVGATE_BASE_URL.description: Your InvGate instance URL, e.g. https://acme.sd.cloud.invgate.net

INVGATE_API_TOKEN.title: InvGate API Token
INVGATE_API_TOKEN.description: API token used to authenticate against the InvGate Service Desk API.

INVGATE_WRITE_PROFILE.title: Write Profile
INVGATE_WRITE_PROFILE.description: Which write operations are enabled: none (read-only, default), support, or full.
